details:
In this project, we tried to design and implement, with high precision and in a completely specialized and professional manner, the complete English version of the Space Mission Design Game with all advanced features, including sandbox mode, team competitive mode, interactive spacecraft visualization (simple and realistic), real-time resource consumption dashboard, leaderboard, final comprehensive report, configuration sharing code, and side-by-side design comparison.

Key Features of this Version (in English)

Full Game Modes: Supports Solo, 4-player Co-op, Competitive to solve a common goal, and a free-form Sandbox with no budget or mass restrictions.

Live Spacecraft Modeling and Visualization: Switch between Simplified and Realistic models with interactive spacecraft previews that change as each piece is installed.

Real-time Engineering Balance and Dashboard: Show the real-time consequences of each choice on mass, power, cost, data rate, and lifespan, along with a live telemetry dashboard and unexpected events during the flight.

Save, Share, Compare, and Rank: Generate Config Code to save and reload designs, compare multiple missions side by side, get a full mission completion report, analyze reasons for success or failure, and record records on the Leaderboard
